name: Eating The Right Foods
overview: Scripture reveals that God originally provided humanity with plants and fruits for nourishment, as seen in Genesis 1:29, and later expanded this provision to include animals after the Flood (Genesis 9:3). The Old Testament, including Leviticus 11, outlines specific dietary instructions given by the Lord. Jesus emphasizes that true life depends not merely on physical food but on the Word of God (Matthew 4:4), and He identifies Himself as the bread of life who satisfies spiritual hunger (John 6:35). Additionally, Jesus teaches that what enters the body does not defile the heart, highlighting a distinction between physical food and spiritual purity (Mark 7:19).
